description: Change only the masked area of an image (mask: white = change, black = keep): edit it, remove what is there, replace it, or add something inside it. The model is shown the area marked on a copy of the image; pixels outside the mask are preserved exactly.

action.description: edit: change the area as the prompt says; remove: erase what is there and fill with background (prompt optional, e.g. 'the bin'); replace: put the prompt's subject in its place; add: add the prompt's subject inside the area

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

mask_path.description: Mask image: white = area to change, black = keep (or opaque strokes on a transparent layer)

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

prompt.description: The change, or the subject to add/replace with; optional for remove

quality.description: All run Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps): fast = ~1 MP (the default, fastest); balanced = ~1.5K; quality = native 2K (slowest; edits share 2K with their references)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results; omit or -1 for random. Never reuse the seed the source image was generated with: use a different one or omit it

name: inpaint_image
title: Inpaint image
